profiles.name: Fathul Huzir Ayob
profiles.description: Fathul Huzir Ayob represents Gerik, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. A Parti Wawasan Negara member.

profiles.name: Shamsul Anuar Nasarah
profiles.description: Shamsul Anuar Nasarah represents Lenggong, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs. A UMNO member.

profiles.name: Hamzah Zainudin
profiles.position: Leader of the Opposition; President of Parti Wawasan Negara
profiles.description: Hamzah Zainudin represents Larut, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Leader of the Opposition; President of Parti Wawasan Negara. A Parti Wawasan Negara member.

milestones.title: Process complete citizenship applications within a year
milestones.description: Shamsul Anuar described the Home Ministry’s one-year processing target and continuing monitoring of compliance.
milestones.progress_note: Processing is not automatic approval or citizenship eligibility. A verified compliance rate and completed case denominator were not supplied; the service standard has no single calendar deadline.

milestones.title: Bring at least 500 musicians together for Lenggong’s MegaJamz festival
milestones.description: Shamsul Anuar announced a simultaneous performance intended to promote Lenggong and seek an Asian Book of Records entry.
milestones.progress_note: The festival is scheduled for 29 November 2026, after this review. Announced participation and the record ambition are not completed attendance or a certified record; delivery and percentage remain unknown.

milestones.title: Propose RM500 monthly household assistance in PN’s alternative budget
milestones.description: Hamzah proposed replacing restricted assistance with RM500 a month, or RM6,000 a year, for eligible needy households.
milestones.progress_note: This is an opposition alternative-budget proposal conditional on government power, not an implemented payment programme. Adoption, funded eligibility and disbursement were not verified; outcome and completion remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date.
